summary.name: Tad
summary.one_liner: Tad is a free, cross-platform desktop app for viewing and analyzing tabular data such as CSV and Parquet files, SQLite and DuckDB databases, with a pivot-table style interface.
use_cases: Viewing large CSV or Parquet files
Browsing SQLite or DuckDB database tables
Quick browsing of a directory of data files
summary.what_it_does: Tad opens CSV, TSV, Parquet, and compressed CSV files, plus SQLite and DuckDB database files, and supports large files. It provides a pivot-table style interface for analyzing and exploring data, and uses DuckDB internally for processing. Users can apply filters, export filtered tables as CSV or Parquet, and get interactive histograms for numeric columns. It can also open a directory of data files and includes a Data Sources sidebar for switching between tables and files.
notable: Uses DuckDB internally for fast processing of large files
Pivot-table style analysis of tabular data
Opens CSV, Parquet, SQLite and DuckDB files directly from the command line
Listed in awesome-mac under Others as open-source freeware
caveats: Described by its author as a perpetual work-in-progress hobby project, so bugs and UI annoyances are likely
Pre-built installers are provided for macOS (x86 and Apple Silicon), Linux, and Windows; other formats such as RPM are on the GitHub releases page
